hero.h1: Trenchless Sewer Repair in Mokena, IL
hero.sub: In a Mokena subdivision, the sewer line usually runs under a driveway, a front walk or a landscaped yard you've spent years on. Trenchless repair fixes the pipe through small openings, so most of that stays put. From our office on Jodi Road.

blocks.body: Trenchless sewer repair, also called no-dig sewer repair, fixes a damaged pipe without digging a trench along its full length. Instead of opening up your yard from the house to the street, we work through one or two access points and repair the pipe from the inside or replace it in place. There are two main methods: cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining and pipe bursting. Both fix the line underground, so what's above it stays untouched.

img.alt: Two J. Blanton plumbers setting up sewer camera and cable equipment beside a home's foundation before a trenchless sewer repair

blocks.h2: Trenchless Sewer Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Can you line a sewer that runs under my driveway?
items.answer: Usually. The liner goes in through a cleanout or a small opening at one end, so the driveway can stay in place.

items.q: Can a PVC line be lined?
items.preview: Yes, if it holds its shape.
items.answer: Yes. Lining works on PVC, clay and cast iron, as long as the pipe is still round and open enough for the liner.

items.q: How long does a liner last?
items.answer: Liners are designed to last for decades, with no joints for roots to get through.

items.q: How long does a trenchless job take?
items.answer: Many residential jobs are done in a day or two, depending on the length of the line and the method.

items.q: How much does trenchless sewer repair cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on length, depth and method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on how much of the line needs work, the depth, the method and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
